production_handoff.on_failure: Stop the pair. Each endpoint still receives its own native scene judge. No force, accept-best, independent retake/correction, look-alike purchase, invented still alias or edited manifest can establish reuse. Correct both ends together, repeat exact source/visual binding and stay inside the ordinary account/take caps.
actual_verification_required: Read both real keyframes manifest entries, require both native judges to pass and require the same selected actual file path and SHA256; independently hash the bytes.
After trim/crop, compare the final referenced derived files and their actual SHA256, not just the original generated-file hash. If they differ, stop and resolve through the ordinary workflow.
